expectedText: Bring it, please. We can put it beside the map of the lake and the ocean. The geography teacher is drawing arrows to show where the water goes. I will make a second card about ecology and conservation, too. It can ask visitors how their choices affect a natural place. Great. After the event, the ideas are read by the club, and we choose one to try the following month.
